title: Fail the Biome check on warnings after clearing the 18 existing ones
body:
Outcome: npm run lint runs `biome check --error-on-warnings`, so a new warning or an unused suppression fails the lint step.
Evidence: package.json lint is `biome check . && node scripts/boundaries.ts` without --error-on-warnings; `npx biome lint .` on 0486d86 reports 18 warnings and 3 infos (7 dead code, 7 noTemplateCurlyInString), in files such as scripts/fast-check.ts, src/hosts/systemd-scope.ts and test/helpers/herdr-stub.ts.
Source: finding LT4 in .krn/runs/lead/t3code-agentic/lanes/t3-lint-test.md (t3code reports unused disable directives as errors).
Acceptance: `biome check --error-on-warnings .` exits 0 on main and is the lint step; a seeded unused import or unused suppression fails npm run lint.
